summary: Caloocan City 1st District representative with 29 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are an anti-dynasty ban and expanded coverage of the espionage law; one issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
